'''Bari''' is a servant in the [[Royal Palace of Andor]], who has served there for twenty-two years.

==Appearance==
He is round-faced.

==Activities==
Bari comes to the apartments of [[Rand al'Thor]] to inform him that three [[Ogier]]; [[Elder]] [[Haman]], Speaker [[Covril]], and [[Erith]] have arrived in the palace.
